تستتفهوا (form X)
# تَسْتَتْفِهُوا (tastatfihū) /tas.tat.fi.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# تُسْتَتْفَهُوا (tustatfahū) /tus.tat.fa.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
